notes:
- Install is now a single file: pipeline_menu.py. BIAS.py and userSetup.py are no longer shipped
- Increment is built in (replaces the BIAS plug-in): bumps only the file name's version, 'Make Latest' picks the true highest version, and the render Version Label is saved with each version. The old BIAS.py is unloaded and removed automatically
- userSetup.py: TP_pipe now keeps its own marked block in it and leaves your other code alone (old TP_pipe sections are migrated automatically; backup in scripts/tp_pipe_backup)
- Uninstall hands File > Increment and Save back to Maya and removes only TP_pipe's userSetup.py block
